request.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into a secret-society gondola: the hull becomes long glossy indigo-blue lacquer #4a43b5 with shade #372f8f and a tall polished brass prow #c9a24a curled like a tentacle tip; the red sail becomes a small sail in indigo-blue and pale cream #f3e7c4 stripes; the red pennant becomes one small lantern with a bright green flame at the stern. Nothing red. Keep the mast, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
